note: Dose ladder for the missing population: every fleet rule is fpr_only because no attacked arm shares a population with the clean null. Arms are DERIVED from the existing clean real-backbone detectors by post-hoc weight edits (tamper_head / tamper_prune), so a ladder costs evaluation time, not training time. The pilot places the ladder and validates the arm contract; the full sweep sizes each (kind, dose) cell from the power table.

weight_tamper.note: unstructured head noise; the existing battery uses the single dose 0.25

substitution.note: structural unit removal; the existing battery uses the single dose 0.25

seeds.full: every clean real-backbone detector in runs/real_cifar

target.note: delta sizes the arms needed to DETECT a 5-point TPR difference; half_width sizes the arms needed to MEASURE a cell to +/-10 points. They are different questions and the plan reports both.
